envelope.description: Port additions and the GitHub adapter: readSignoffRequest and readSignoffState(since)

body.title: Port additions and the GitHub adapter: readSignoffRequest and readSignoffState(since)
body.summary: Add the optional readSignoffRequest(ref) -> { branch, open } and the optional `since` argument on readSignoffState to the tracker port (the sc1 amendment AMD-27), and implement both in the GitHub adapter: readSignoffRequest through gh pr view --json headRefName,state, and readSignoffState with since through gh pr view --json state,mergedAt,reviews using each reviewer's latest decisive review (APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED or DISMISSED; COMMENTED ignored) made after since; a closed unmerged request stays changes-requested; with no since the answer is as in s7.
acceptanceChecks: The port declares readSignoffRequest as optional and readSignoffState with an optional since, and a tracker without them still type-checks
readSignoffRequest maps headRefName and OPEN, MERGED and CLOSED to { branch, open } and rejects a malformed ref and unreadable output with the port failure kinds

readSignoffState with since treats a CHANGES_REQUESTED review at or before since as open, one after as changes-requested, a later approval as clearing it, and a COMMENTED review as neither clearing nor creating it
readSignoffState without since returns exactly what s7 returned

tests.name: src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-signoff-revise.test.ts: readSignoffRequest maps headRefName and OPEN, MERGED and CLOSED to a branch and openness, and rejects a malformed ref and unreadable output
